title: Family dinner
show: Original, in the style of a family comedy

lines.hanzi: 多吃点儿，这个鱼是你最爱吃的。
lines.pinyin: duō chī diǎnr, zhège yú shì nǐ zuì ài chī de.
lines.english: Eat more. This fish is your favorite.

paraphrase.hanzi: 来，再吃点儿鱼，你不是最喜欢吃鱼吗？
paraphrase.pinyin: lái, zài chī diǎnr yú, nǐ bú shì zuì xǐhuan chī yú ma?
paraphrase.english: Come on, have some more fish. Isn't fish what you like best?

swap.hanzi: 多吃点儿，这个鸡蛋是你最爱吃的。
swap.pinyin: duō chī diǎnr, zhège jīdàn shì nǐ zuì ài chī de.
swap.english: Eat more. These eggs are your favorite.

reply.hanzi: 妈，我已经吃了很多鸡蛋了。
reply.pinyin: mā, wǒ yǐjīng chī le hěn duō jīdàn le.
reply.english: Mom, I've already eaten a lot of eggs.

detour.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng hē shuǐ ma? niúnǎi yě yǒu.
detour.english: Do you want some water? There's milk too.

detour.pinyin: hē shuǐ jiù hǎo, xièxie mā.

steerBack.hanzi: 好，给你水。来，多吃点儿，这个鱼是你最爱吃的。
steerBack.pinyin: hǎo, gěi nǐ shuǐ. lái, duō chī diǎnr, zhège yú shì nǐ zuì ài chī de.
steerBack.english: Okay, here's your water. Now eat more, this fish is your favorite.

lines.pinyin: mā, wǒ yǐjīng chī le hěn duō le.
lines.english: Mom, I've already eaten a lot.

lines.hanzi: 就吃这么一点儿？你看你，工作那么忙，也不好好吃饭。
lines.pinyin: jiù chī zhème yì diǎnr? nǐ kàn nǐ, gōngzuò nàme máng, yě bù hǎohǎo chīfàn.
lines.english: That's all you're eating? Look at you, so busy with work and not even eating properly.

paraphrase.hanzi: 你吃得太少了！工作这么忙，要好好吃饭。
paraphrase.pinyin: nǐ chī de tài shǎo le! gōngzuò zhème máng, yào hǎohǎo chīfàn.
paraphrase.english: You're not eating enough! With work this busy, you need to eat properly.

swap.changes: habit: not eating properly becomes not sleeping properly
swap.hanzi: 你看你，工作那么忙，也不好好睡觉。
swap.pinyin: nǐ kàn nǐ, gōngzuò nàme máng, yě bù hǎohǎo shuìjiào.
swap.english: Look at you, so busy with work and not even sleeping properly.

reply.hanzi: 我天天都好好睡觉，妈，你别说了。
reply.pinyin: wǒ tiāntiān dōu hǎohǎo shuìjiào, mā, nǐ bié shuō le.
reply.english: I sleep properly every day. Mom, stop talking about it.

detour.pinyin: nǐ jīntiān jǐ diǎn xiàbān de?
detour.english: What time did you get off work today?

detour.pinyin: liù diǎn xiàbān, qī diǎn dào jiā.
detour.english: I got off at six and was home by seven.

steerBack.hanzi: 这么晚！工作那么忙，要好好吃饭。
steerBack.pinyin: zhème wǎn! gōngzuò nàme máng, yào hǎohǎo chīfàn.
steerBack.english: So late! With work that busy, you need to eat properly.

lines.hanzi: 我天天都好好吃饭，妈，你别说了。
lines.pinyin: wǒ tiāntiān dōu hǎohǎo chīfàn, mā, nǐ bié shuō le.
lines.english: I eat properly every day. Mom, stop talking about it.

lines.hanzi: 对了，你最近有没有女朋友？
lines.pinyin: duì le, nǐ zuìjìn yǒu méi yǒu nǚ péngyou?
lines.english: By the way, have you got a girlfriend lately?

paraphrase.hanzi: 对了，你现在有女朋友了吗？
paraphrase.pinyin: duì le, nǐ xiànzài yǒu nǚ péngyou le ma?
paraphrase.english: By the way, do you have a girlfriend now?

swap.changes: who is asking: Mom's own question becomes a rumor from your sister
swap.hanzi: 对了，你妹妹说你有女朋友了，是真的吗？
swap.pinyin: duì le, nǐ mèimei shuō nǐ yǒu nǚ péngyou le, shì zhēn de ma?
swap.english: By the way, your sister says you have a girlfriend. Is it true?

reply.hanzi: 不是真的！妹妹是说着玩儿的。这个鱼真好吃！
reply.pinyin: bú shì zhēn de! mèimei shì shuō zhe wánr de. zhège yú zhēn hǎochī!
reply.english: It's not true! My sister was just kidding. This fish is so good!

detour.hanzi: 对了，你星期六有时间吗？
detour.pinyin: duì le, nǐ xīngqīliù yǒu shíjiān ma?
detour.english: By the way, are you free on Saturday?

steerBack.hanzi: 我朋友的女儿很漂亮，你想认识她吗？
steerBack.pinyin: wǒ péngyou de nǚ'ér hěn piàoliang, nǐ xiǎng rènshi tā ma?
steerBack.english: My friend's daughter is very pretty. Do you want to meet her?

lines.hanzi: 妈，这个鱼真好吃！是你做的吗？
lines.pinyin: mā, zhège yú zhēn hǎochī! shì nǐ zuò de ma?
lines.english: Mom, this fish is so good! Did you make it?

lines.hanzi: 别说鱼了。我问你呢，你有没有喜欢的人？
lines.pinyin: bié shuō yú le. wǒ wèn nǐ ne, nǐ yǒu méi yǒu xǐhuan de rén?
lines.english: Forget the fish. I'm asking you: is there someone you like?

paraphrase.hanzi: 鱼先不说。我问你，你有喜欢的人吗？
paraphrase.pinyin: yú xiān bù shuō. wǒ wèn nǐ, nǐ yǒu xǐhuan de rén ma?
paraphrase.english: Never mind the fish for now. I'm asking you, is there someone you like?

swap.changes: question: 'is there someone you like' becomes 'who is the person you like most'
swap.hanzi: 别说鱼了。我问你呢，你最喜欢的人是谁？
swap.pinyin: bié shuō yú le. wǒ wèn nǐ ne, nǐ zuì xǐhuan de rén shì shéi?
swap.english: Forget the fish. I'm asking you: who is the person you like most?

reply.pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐhuan de rén jiù shì nǐ!
reply.english: The person I like most is you!

detour.hanzi: 不给不给，手机里没有什么！
detour.pinyin: bù gěi bù gěi, shǒujī lǐ méiyǒu shénme!
detour.english: No way, there's nothing on my phone!

steerBack.hanzi: 好，不看就不看。那你告诉我，你有没有喜欢的人？
steerBack.pinyin: hǎo, bú kàn jiù bú kàn. nà nǐ gàosu wǒ, nǐ yǒu méi yǒu xǐhuan de rén?
steerBack.english: Fine, I won't look. Then you tell me: is there someone you like?

lines.hanzi: 有，有，有！我最喜欢的人就是你。
lines.pinyin: yǒu, yǒu, yǒu! wǒ zuì xǐhuan de rén jiù shì nǐ.
lines.english: Yes, yes, yes! The person I like most is you.

lines.hanzi: 少来！我说真的。你也不小了，我和你爸都希望你有个家。
lines.pinyin: shǎo lái! wǒ shuō zhēn de. nǐ yě bù xiǎo le, wǒ hé nǐ bà dōu xīwàng nǐ yǒu ge jiā.
lines.english: Cut it out! I'm serious. You're not young anymore, and your dad and I want you to have a family of your own.

paraphrase.hanzi: 少来！我不是说着玩儿的。你也不小了，爸爸和我都希望你有个家。
paraphrase.pinyin: shǎo lái! wǒ bú shì shuō zhe wánr de. nǐ yě bù xiǎo le, bàba hé wǒ dōu xīwàng nǐ yǒu ge jiā.
paraphrase.english: Cut it out! I'm not joking. You're not young anymore, and your dad and I want you to have a family of your own.

swap.changes: what the parents hope for: a family of your own becomes more rest
swap.hanzi: 少来！我说真的。你工作太忙了，我和你爸都希望你多休息。
swap.pinyin: shǎo lái! wǒ shuō zhēn de. nǐ gōngzuò tài máng le, wǒ hé nǐ bà dōu xīwàng nǐ duō xiūxi.
swap.english: Cut it out! I'm serious. You work too much, and your dad and I want you to rest more.

reply.hanzi: 好好好，我知道了。以后我多休息。
reply.pinyin: hǎo hǎo hǎo, wǒ zhīdao le. yǐhòu wǒ duō xiūxi.
reply.english: Okay, okay, okay, I know. I'll rest more from now on.

detour.hanzi: 你知道吗？我三十岁的时候，你已经三岁了。
detour.pinyin: nǐ zhīdao ma? wǒ sānshí suì de shíhou, nǐ yǐjīng sān suì le.
detour.english: You know what? When I was thirty, you were already three.

detour.hanzi: 我知道，你说过很多次了。
detour.pinyin: wǒ zhīdao, nǐ shuō guo hěn duō cì le.
detour.english: I know, you've told me many times.

steerBack.hanzi: 那你也要快一点儿。我说真的，爸爸和我都希望你有个家。
steerBack.pinyin: nà nǐ yě yào kuài yì diǎnr. wǒ shuō zhēn de, bàba hé wǒ dōu xīwàng nǐ yǒu ge jiā.
steerBack.english: Then you should hurry up a bit. I'm serious, your dad and I want you to have a family of your own.

lines.hanzi: 好好好，我知道了。有了女朋友，我第一个告诉你。
lines.pinyin: hǎo hǎo hǎo, wǒ zhīdao le. yǒu le nǚ péngyou, wǒ dì yī ge gàosu nǐ.
lines.english: Okay, okay, okay, I know. When I have a girlfriend, you'll be the first to hear.
